answer.reason: The instance has a "Carousel" component (referenceName: carousel) that renders a slider, with its Slides field being a nested linked-content grid pointing to the "Carousel Slide" content model (referenceName: carouselSlide). This model has the fields needed for a product screenshot slide — heading, description, a Background Image attachment (for the screenshot), and an optional CTA link. There is no separate "screenshot" or "slider" specific model; sliders on this instance are built from Carousel + carouselSlide items (seen in use on pages like contactus and testpage via nested containers such as contactus_Carousel_CarouselSlide). Therefore, a new slide for the product screenshot slider should be created as a new carouselSlide content item nested under the relevant page's Carousel component.
